card.name: First part of compound medical terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a compound or split word where the rest of the word follows next, such as inhal(ation), non-verte(bral), meal(time), loop (of Henle or diuretics). It also fires on a head noun like tissue or tract inside a body-system phrase.

modes.label: Word start before its ending
modes.description: A word cut in two, with the stem here and the ending to come.

modes.label: Body-system or drug-class noun
modes.description: A noun like loop, tissue or tract that is part of a longer anatomical or drug-class phrase.
modes.example: such as<< loop>> or thiazide diuretics)

modes.label: Compound adjective stem
modes.description: A modifier piece joined to a following noun, as in meal-time or military tribunals.
modes.example: convert each injected<< meal>>time insulin dosage

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and the suppressed ones are mostly word fragments.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a longer medical term, just before the rest of the word arrives.
